description:
## Goal

Retain the canonical empty lattice constant alongside `any`, so a request for `none()` and the exact law `difference(t, t) = none` return an existing `Ty` without rebuilding, hashing, or probing a descriptor.

## Strategy

Construct `any` and `none` once at `Types` creation, preserve the existing append-only type identity model, and short-circuit equal operands before the binary-operation table. Test the semantic law and boundary-work invariant; document why both constants are retained.

## Acceptance

Focused type and fixture canary tests, canonical corpus gate, formatting, check, strict Clippy, and the full workspace suite pass. No second descriptor-index authority or normalized-descriptor cache is introduced.
title: Retain the canonical empty Ty
